blocks.text: Scatterplots display relationships between two variables. Each point represents an observation, and the position on the graph indicates values for both variables.
Example: A scatterplot can be used to explore the relationship between the number of hours studied and exam scores.

blocks.alt: Scatterplot with Hours from 0 to 10 across and scores from 0 to 100 up. Thirteen points rise from about 40 at 0 hours to about 95 at 8 hours.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.7: Scatterplot showing the relationship between hours studied and exam scores (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 5.7).
